say:1:1710809001:1.text: Magister Merlin! Good morning! Looks like the whole city's heard by now. Have you... heard about the "sacred trial" at the banquet last night?
say:1:1710809001:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下！早安！我看全城都已经传遍了，您……您也听说昨...
say:1:1710809001:1.male: Magister Merlin! Good morning! Looks like the whole city's heard by now. Have you... heard about the "sacred trial" at the banquet last night?
say:1:1710809001:1.female: Magister Merlin! Good morning! Looks like the whole city's heard by now. Have you... heard about the "sacred trial" at the banquet last night?

choice_prompt:2:1710809001.text: Magister Merlin! Good morning! Looks like the whole city's heard by now. Have you... heard about the "sacred trial" at the banquet last night?
choice_prompt:2:1710809001.source_cn: 梅林阁下！早安！我看全城都已经传遍了，您……您也听说昨晚王宫宴会上的“神圣试炼”了吗？
choice_prompt:2:1710809001.male: Magister Merlin! Good morning! Looks like the whole city's heard by now. Have you... heard about the "sacred trial" at the banquet last night?
choice_prompt:2:1710809001.female: Magister Merlin! Good morning! Looks like the whole city's heard by now. Have you... heard about the "sacred trial" at the banquet last night?

say:3:1710809002:1.text: Dura above! Then you need to hear it from someone who was actually there!
say:3:1710809002:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！那您可得听听第一手消息！
say:3:1710809002:1.male: Dura above! Then you need to hear it from someone who was actually there!
say:3:1710809002:1.female: Dura above! Then you need to hear it from someone who was actually there!

say:4:1710809003:1.text: I was standing guard last night outside the banquet hall. I saw those nobles go in with my own eyes, and saw them come out too!
say:4:1710809003:1.source_cn: 我昨晚就在宴会厅外站岗，可是亲眼看着那些贵族大人们进去...
say:4:1710809003:1.male: I was standing guard last night outside the banquet hall. I saw those nobles go in with my own eyes, and saw them come out too!
say:4:1710809003:1.female: I was standing guard last night outside the banquet hall. I saw those nobles go in with my own eyes, and saw them come out too!

say:5:1710809004:1.text: They said that a ray of divine light descended out of nowhere! It swept them up along with the Prince and carried them straight to the Hall of Ancients!
say:5:1710809004:1.source_cn: 据大人们出来后描述——就在宴会最热烈的时候，一道圣光降...
say:5:1710809004:1.male: They said that a ray of divine light descended out of nowhere! It swept them up along with the Prince and carried them straight to the Hall of Ancients!
say:5:1710809004:1.female: They said that a ray of divine light descended out of nowhere! It swept them up along with the Prince and carried them straight to the Hall of Ancients!

say:7:1710809005:1.source_cn: 直接召唤到了圣古堂？！然后呢？

say:8:1710809006:1.text: Then they ran into a Hypofiend. And not just any Hypofiend, I heard it was the Mirror Wraith from the history books! The same one King Rolan faced!
say:8:1710809006:1.source_cn: 然后他们就遇上了魔物！而且不是普通的魔物，听说是史书里...

say:9:1710809007:1.source_cn: 艾雅啊！那岂不是凶多吉少？

say:10:1710809008:1.text: Ah, but here's the thing! When Baron Grandet and Minister Corsten left this morning, they were congratulating each other at the gates!
say:10:1710809008:1.source_cn: 这你就不懂了！今早葛朗台男爵和康斯曼大臣离开的时候，还...

say:11:1710809009:1.text: They claimed that when the monsters attacked, not a single noble backed down. With fearless courage, they aided His Highness in battling the ancient fiend!
say:11:1710809009:1.source_cn: 他们说，面对魔物，我们的贵族大人们……没有一个退缩！他...

say:12:1710809010:1.text: You expect me to believe those old lords actually fought?
say:12:1710809010:1.source_cn: 真的假的？那群老爷们还能战斗？

say:13:1710809011:1.text: True or not, that's the story they're telling—they created an opening for His Highness!
say:13:1710809011:1.source_cn: 不管能不能打，反正他们是这么说的——他们为殿下创造了机会！

say:14:1710809012:1.text: And Prince Orion seized it. Amidst countless mirror images, he shattered the monster's core in one strike!
say:14:1710809012:1.source_cn: 而奥利安殿下抓住了那个机会，在万千镜影中，一举击碎了魔...

say:15:1710809013:1.text: But here's the best part. After the monster fell, His Highness was bathed in divine light, and declared he had passed the Goddess' trial!
say:15:1710809013:1.source_cn: 最关键的是后面！大人们说，魔物倒下后，殿下全身环绕着圣...

say:16:1710809014:1.text: To make sure everyone was safe, His Highness used his divine power to send the nobles back first.
say:16:1710809014:1.source_cn: 为了让大家安全，殿下动用神力把贵族们先送了回来。

say:17:1710809015:1.text: And he... he chose to stay behind, alone. He said he would master that power himself, and return to the Empire with the vanished Hall of Ancients!
say:17:1710809015:1.source_cn: 而他自己……选择独自留在那里！他说，他要亲自驾驭那股力...

say:18:1710809016:1.text: Bringing the Hall of Ancients back...? Dura preserve us... It's like King Rolan reborn! Just hearing about it gives me chills!
say:18:1710809016:1.source_cn: 独自一人……把圣古堂带回来？艾雅庇佑……这简直就是罗兰...

say:19:1710809017:1.text: You said it! No one slept last night.
say:19:1710809017:1.source_cn: 可不是吗！昨晚大家都没睡着，都在等着那一刻呢！

choice_prompt:20:1710809017.text: You said it! No one slept last night.
choice_prompt:20:1710809017.source_cn: 可不是吗！昨晚大家都没睡着，都在等着那一刻呢！

say:21:1710809018:1.text: You're right, Magister! As Merlin, it's only fitting you witness a sacred moment like this!
say:21:1710809018:1.source_cn: 您说得对！梅林阁下！您是大魔法师，这种神圣的时刻，理应...
say:21:1710809018:1.male: You're right, Magister! As Merlin, it's only fitting you witness a sacred moment like this!
say:21:1710809018:1.female: You're right, Magister! As Merlin, it's only fitting you witness a sacred moment like this!

say:22:1710809019:1.text: Half the city's already heading to the plaza. You should head over too!
say:22:1710809019:1.source_cn: 现在已经有很多人往广场方向去了！您也早点过去吧！
say:22:1710809019:1.male: Half the city's already heading to the plaza. You should head over too!
say:22:1710809019:1.female: Half the city's already heading to the plaza. You should head over too!

choice:20:1:2.text: Now I really have to see this.
choice:20:1:2.male: Now I really have to see this.
choice:20:1:2.female: Now I really have to see this.

choice:2:0:1.text: I just woke up, haven't heard a thing.
choice:2:0:1.male: I just woke up, haven't heard a thing.
choice:2:0:1.female: I just woke up, haven't heard a thing.
